p.write_text('''from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    full = [v for v in range(10) if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid) or any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))]
    sep = full[0]
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def ranges(seps, limit):
        out=[]; start=0
        for s in seps+[limit]:
            if s>start: out.append((start,s))
            start=s+1
        return out
    rr, cc = ranges(hr,h), ranges(vc,w)
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep)
    background=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)) == 2 else background for x,y in cc] for a,b in rr]
''')
